versions.changelog: 默认返回最终采集结果，完善异步等待下载与安全恢复；修复空目标误执行、Quick Start、Token 配置和触发路由冲突，并补齐发布前自动化测试
新增能力路由与异步任务闭环，修复失效引用、Token 泄漏和 Skill 元数据兼容性
补全中文文档，更新目录结构

Initial release of the YouTube comment collection tool for Dataify.

- Allows users to submit YouTube comment collection jobs by video ID using Dataify Builder.
- Guides users through parameter selection with a confirmation Markdown table and option to change values or collect multiple groups.
- Manages Dataify API TOKEN usage, including detection, prompting, and secure saving instructions.
- Submits parameter groups as a normalized JSON array and handles both single and multi-group requests.
- On successful task creation, provides `task_id`, status, and dashboard link for result management.
- Includes troubleshooting steps for missing tokens and common user errors.
